description: This file defines the Operations class, which manages registration, retrieval, and listing of Operation objects within a calculator application. It includes methods for registering operations, resetting the registry, fetching specific operations by name, and retrieving sorted operation names.

classes.name: Operations
classes.description: A singleton class that manages a collection of Operation objects, allowing registration, retrieval, and listing of operations.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers a new Operation object into the commands map, asserting that the operation's name is not already registered.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Clears all registered operations from the commands map.

methods.name: getOperation
methods.description: Retrieves an Operation object by its name.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of registered operations.

methods.name: getOperationName
methods.description: Returns the name of the operation at the specified index after sorting the operation names alphabetically.
